AssertionError: Expected Instagram URL 'https://www.instagram.com/yedyni.ruh/', but got 'https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fyedyni.ruh%2F&is_from_rle'
assert False
 +  where False = <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x7fef2c0d4210>('https://www.instagram.com/yedyni.ruh/')
 +    where <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x7fef2c0d4210> = 'https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fyedyni.ruh%2F&is_from_rle'.startswith
 +      where 'https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fyedyni.ruh%2F&is_from_rle' = <selenium.webdriver.chrome.webdriver.WebDriver (session="2e4d9b1b7759869a4a164d3d43dd9e0b")>.current_url
TC-44: Verify Instagram social media link functionality
